cart.text: A cart heaped with dried cactus spines and something dark and rubbery coiled in a bucket. {{vendor_name}} grins with too many teeth and not enough of them straight.

choices.label: Ask what the spines are for.

the_spines.text: 'Bundle three tight and they scream when they fly,' {{vendor_name}} says, demonstrating on a fence post that now has a hole in it. 'Scares the life out of whatever's listening. Sometimes yours too.'

choices.label: Ask about the thing in the bucket.

the_bucket.text: 'Tentacle. Still twitches if you poke it, don't ask.' {{vendor_name}} snaps off a length and hands it over. 'Whittle it right and it flies true. Sticks in whatever's chasing you, and it panics.'

spine_prick.text: A spine gets you before you can pull your hand back. It stings for hours.

it_moved.text: The thing in the bucket moves on its own. You decide not to find out why.
